key_insight: GRPO can narrow reasoning diversity by over-rewarding already likely responses and tokens, while ReCo reweights both effects to preserve broader coverage of solution paths.
engineering_relevance: For post-training math LMs, ReCo offers a drop-in training adjustment that better maintains Pass@k at large k without sacrificing small-k performance.
method: Normalize each response’s contribution by its expected frequency in the rollout group.
Replace token-level importance ratios with a variance-based ratio that amplifies non-saturated decision points.
Target both repeated-response dominance and token-scale reinforcement in the GRPO update.
evidence_signal: Across Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/7B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on five math benchmarks, ReCo improved large-k Pass@k and matched GRPO at small k.
watch_item: The variance-based reweighting may be sensitive to rollout statistics and implementation details, so training stability should be checked carefully.
paper_title: ReCo: Reweighting GRPO Against Distributional Concentration
